name: Adobo Sauce
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in small serving sizes. Watch for garlic powder in commercial varieties which may cause symptoms.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels for garlic powder or onion powder
Make homemade version with garlic-infused oil instead of garlic powder
Start with smaller amounts to test tolerance
Store opened cans in refrigerator and use within one week
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in vitamin C from peppers
Source of antioxidants from smoked peppers
